semanticReview.scope: Manual review of all 16 final synthetic model outputs; 12 preceding samples retained for comparison. No downstream tasks were executed and no v1.0.0 performance baseline was measured.
observableImprovements: The final CSV sample retains lowercase email.
Several explicitly requested answer languages are no longer listed as inferred assumptions.
Both final Traditional Chinese instruction samples use Japanese review notes as requested.
Existing verification methods are no longer reported as an assumption in the final Traditional Chinese coding sample.

remainingIssues.detail: Two English-source samples omit an explicit inferred answer language and corresponding assumption; three samples incorrectly list an explicitly requested language as an assumption.

The missing-options sample omits the ask-first rule for criteria that are supplied but insufficient. A coding sample uses an unqualified prohibition on claiming inspection; one improvement note claims interface preservation more strongly than its prompt.
The model guidance initially restates the drafting task before replacing it with a conflict notice. The English-mode conflict samples give a direct no-drafting instruction.

semanticReview.conclusion: Partial observed improvements, with remaining semantic errors. These samples do not establish cross-language equivalence, universal fidelity or improved downstream task performance.
